title: Amazon Web Services IAM user access key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: AIDA (provider-documented IAM user unique ID) vs AKIA access key and prefix namespace: AIDA (provider-documented IAM user unique ID) vs ASIA access key. Twin of "Amazon Web Services IAM user access key: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
